title: Teenmaar Dance Steps Tutorial | Chatal Band Steps | Marfa Dance | PART 1 | MGS Dance Studio

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The instructor explains the cultural context and energy of Marfa/Teenmaar dance before breaking down individual steps. He provides clear step-by-step instructions for footwork and arm movements while counting and encouraging the viewer.

lesson_structure.note: Introduction of the choreographer Shankar at MGS Dance Studio.
Discussion on the energy of Teenmaar drums and DJ music.
Step 1 breakdown with leg and arm coordination.
Step 2 breakdown with side turn and shoulder movement.
Step 3 breakdown with toe balance and shoulder shrugs.

steps_taught.name: Step 2

steps_taught.name: Step 3
steps_taught.description: Toe balance with shoulder shimmies and body bounce.

steps_taught.name: Step 4

quotes.text: My name is Shankar, welcome to MGS Dance Studio.
